expectations.text: The chart is in a fenced code block (so it stays aligned)
If the chart is framed, every line has the same display width
Only font-safe glyphs (ASCII, Latin-1, WGL4 box drawing, shades, half blocks, markers)
Refunds hang left and income stacks right of zero, in every month
Every month's zero is at the same column (one shared zero line)
Subscriptions and services are two segments told apart by glyph, the same glyph every month
Segment lengths are proportional to the values (±1 cell of round(v / max × longest))
A legend names the three series
